scientific_integrity: Analytical singular-perturbation proof supplemented by 265 repeatable finite-dimensional checks; no independent priority or mathematical validation.
scientific_limitations: Four-state one-electron global secular load master equation; no simultaneous charging bath or dephasing.
Large-detuning asymptotic with the load chemical potential tracking the high-energy eigenvalue.
The complete finite-detuning output can have behavior outside the proven quadratic-time window.
Other charge sectors, phonons, orbital levels, reservoir feedback and finite-capacity loads are not included.
title: A quadratic-time reversal of electrochemical work in a detuned quantum-dot load
